summary: Level-5 and Sony's standalone space-pirate action RPG for PlayStation 2, later converted for PlayStation 4.

entries.title: Rogue Galaxy

emulation.notes: Use official PS4 release for the main route; use PCSX2 only with legal disc dumps if local enhancement testing is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official PS4 up-rendering or higher internal resolution in PCSX2.

primary.why: The PS4 conversion is the current official route and adds up-rendering and trophies while preserving the PS2 game; it is the simplest capture recommendation.
primary.how_to_play: Buy/play Rogue Galaxy on PlayStation Store for PS4 or PS5 backward compatibility. Use PCSX2 with a legal PS2 disc dump only for local comparison.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release; the enhanced Director's Cut formed the international release basis.
all_releases.reason: skip: original route, but PS4 conversion is current and capture-friendly.

all_releases.fidelity: Converted PS2 release for PS4 with up-rendering and trophies.
all_releases.reason: primary: current official route and easiest capture option.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The PS4 version is an official conversion of the PS2 game.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a converted/emulated PS2 release, not a full remaster.
